name: Time-Lapse ROI Profiling and Data Extraction
description:
Perform quantitative time-series analysis on the 'Mitosis' 5D hyperstack sample. 

1. Open the sample image 'Mitosis (26MB, 5D stack)' via File > Open Samples.
2. Create a Maximum Intensity Projection (Image > Stacks > Z Project...) to collapse the Z-dimension while preserving the time series (Result should be a multichannel time-lapse).
3. Select the Red channel (Microtubules) for analysis (you can split channels or work on the composite if you select the channel correctly).
4. Identify at least 3 distinct cells/regions.
5. Add these regions to the ROI Manager.
6. Use the ROI Manager's 'Multi-Measure' command to generate intensity traces for all ROIs across all 51 time frames.
7. Save the measurement results to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/time_series_traces.csv'.
8. Save the ROI set to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/cell_rois.zip'.
